purpose: Real public-site motion previews for the Fortune GitHub profile.
scope: Only assets/motion/websites was written; public sites and project checkouts were observed without changes.

files.sourceTitle: Bottega Dei Priori | Trattoria a Perugia
files.sourceState: Current public website observed on capture date; no new release or deployment is implied.
files.sharedProjectCredit: Shared work with Walberth Soares through Civico Due (https://civicodue.eu/).

capture.method: Lossless screenshots from an independent Playwright browser during real wheel input; no DOM, content, or style changes.
capture.action: Homepage food hero, then wheel-scroll 800 CSS pixels into La sala e la tavola and the restaurant photo grid.

export.cadence: Approximately 1.6-second opening hold, 20 observed scroll frames over 2.6 seconds (about 8 fps), and 1.6-second closing hold; GIF timestamp quantization yields 5.84 seconds.
export.transformations: Scale to 600 x 400; normalize frame timing for GIF playback; palette quantization and GIF delta compression only. No title cards, transitions, overlays, reconstructed UI, or added visual effects.

refresh.loadWait: Wait for network idle, then at least 4 seconds for entrance/loading animation; confirm fonts and hero imagery are visible.
refresh.actions: Use only the stated homepage wheel scroll. Do not activate booking, contact, payment, account, or outbound messaging actions.
refresh.review: Inspect decoded opening, scroll, and closing frames; confirm the actual public content and shared credit; verify dimensions, duration, frame count, bytes, and hash after encoding.
